definitions.gloss: activeness; acting of one's own will; active voice
definitions.explanation: Acting on one's own initiative rather than being acted upon; also the grammatical active voice. The antonym of {受動|じゅどう} (passive). Most often seen in the form {能動的|のうどうてき} (active, proactive).

examples.japanese: {能動|のうどう}と{受動|じゅどう}は{対|つい}になる{概念|がいねん}だ。
examples.english: Active and passive are paired concepts.

examples.japanese: {学習|がくしゅう}では{能動|のうどう}の{姿勢|しせい}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: In learning, an active attitude is important.

examples.japanese: {英語|えいご}の{文法|ぶんぽう}では、{能動|のうどう}と{受動|じゅどう}で{動詞|どうし}の{形|かたち}が{変|か}わる。
examples.english: In English grammar, the verb form changes between the active and passive voice.

notes:
The antonym of {受動|じゅどう} (passive). Refers to acting of one's own will, and to the grammatical active voice. Most common in the form {能動的|のうどうてき} (proactive, active).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {能動的|のうどうてき}: active; proactive
- {能動|のうどう}{態|たい}: active voice (grammar)
- {能動|のうどう}{喫煙|きつえん}: active smoking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受動|じゅどう}: passive — the direct antonym
